body.x: Divoom, announced today the Bluetune-solo portable Bluetooth speaker with X-Bass Sound System, and microphone, Colorful and compact.

Bluetune-solo is perfect for students, teens and kids, as well as adults just throw in your bag for instant music. The Bluetune-solo X-bass sound system features patented PO-Bass Technology that provides a deep bass in a compact package and more resonant sound than comparably-priced portable speakers. The Bluetune-solo includes a built-in microphone for hands-free calls and has a built-in rechargeable battery for up to 8 hours of play time.

Designed for on-the-go music enjoyment with an all-in-one button conveniently placed on top for easy access, the Bluetune-solo speaker wirelessly connects to all Bluetooth devices, smartphones, tablets, laptops and more, including iPhones, Androids, BlackBerrys, and iPads. Available in multiple colors: red, blue, white, brown, and black, the Bluetune-solo compact design easily fits into a backpack and is ideal for music listening on vacation, in a dorm room, living room, bedroom, and more. For extra convenience, the speaker also works with devices that don't support Bluetooth through its auxiliary-in port.
The Bluetune-solo will be shown at the International Consumer Electronics Show (CES), held January 8-11, 2013 at the Las Vegas Convention Center in Las Vegas, at the Divoom Booth #6616 North Hall.
